name: dotfiles-rules
description: Project rules for this dotfiles repo: the layer-1 hook bypass (--no-verify), forced pushes, and forced adds. Matching is exact-token only, so 'git add -f secrets/' cannot be scoped to secrets/ and is blocked as a forced add.
author: dotfiles

rules.name: block-commit-no-verify
rules.reason: Skipping hooks bypasses the pre-commit secret scan. Fix the finding instead; the hook prints the pattern, never the value.

rules.name: block-push-force
rules.reason: A forced push rewrites published history and can destroy other clones' work. Ask the user; they run it in their own terminal.

rules.name: block-add-force
rules.reason: A forced add overrides .gitignore and is how a secret file gets staged. Add the ordinary path; secrets/ stays git-crypt'd, not bypassed.
